fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: A suit takes four visits and about twelve weeks

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Aldous & Finch have cut suits on Chiltern Street since 1974. Nothing is hurried, and nothing leaves the shop until it sits properly.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: Say what happens at this visit and how long it takes.

default.name: The conversation
default.text: An hour over coffee about where you will wear it, with two thousand cloths from Yorkshire and Biella to handle.

default.name: The measure
default.text: Twenty-seven measurements, and a pencilled note of how you actually stand when nobody is looking.

default.name: The baste fitting
default.text: Six weeks later you try the suit loosely stitched in white thread, and we chalk every change onto the cloth.

default.name: The finish
default.text: Buttonholes sewn by hand, a final press, and alterations free for as long as you own the suit.
